## Invitations

The outreach activity resulted in 532 invitations being issued. Attendance was 249, giving a rate of 46.8. This provides a clear summary of the response to the invitation programme and indicates that engagement was achieved across the period. Staff continued to support attendance by keeping van days in place where roads allowed. These arrangements helped maintain access for people who might otherwise have faced difficulty reaching the service.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 456 were supported by an SMS contact. No reminder messages were sent, with the reminder total recorded as 0. The contact approach therefore relied on the initial invitation and SMS communication rather than follow-up reminders. The figures have been recorded for the outreach report and should be considered alongside the attendance outcome when reviewing the activity. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
